headline: MOGOTES METALS HITS PAYDIRT: 1.67% Cu, 1.62 g/t Au Discovered Metres from BHP/Lundin's Filo del Sol
snippet: Mogotes Metals (TSXV: MOG) reported high-grade copper-gold-silver-molybdenum results from hole FS_DDH_016 at its Filo Sur project in Argentina's Vicuña District, directly along strike from BHP and Lundin Mining's Filo del Sol discovery. The 'Albor' zone returned 1.67% Cu, 1.62 g/t Au, and 685 ppm Mo from just 125m depth — a second major discovery in the company's inaugural drilling season, with assays pending to 464m.

headline: SILVER SURGES to $88/oz — Two-Month High as Industrial Demand Bets Overpower Inflation Fears
snippet: Silver climbed toward $88 an ounce Friday, its best level in two months and outperforming gold as improved industrial demand prospects from the US-China tariff truce offset macro headwinds. The metal is up more than 150% over the past year and has recovered the bulk of its losses since its January all-time high of $121.64/oz.

headline: GOLD STUMBLES BELOW $4,700 — Hottest US Inflation Since 2023 Buries Rate Cut Hopes
snippet: Gold fell for a second straight session below $4,700/oz after US consumer inflation accelerated to 3.8% — the highest reading since May 2023 — extinguishing expectations of Federal Reserve rate cuts this year. Central banks provided a partial floor, purchasing a net 244 metric tonnes of gold in Q1 2026 at the fastest pace in over a year.

headline: EQUINOX SWALLOWS ORLA: $18.5B Deal Creates North America's New 1.1M oz/Year Gold Powerhouse
snippet: Equinox Gold agreed to acquire Orla Mining in a cash-and-stock deal valued at US$5.1 billion, forming a combined company with an $18.5 billion market cap and expected annual production of 1.1 million ounces from the Greenstone, Valentine, and Musselwhite mines in Canada. Orla shareholders receive one Equinox share per Orla share held; both boards recommend approval ahead of shareholder votes expected in July 2026.

headline: INDIA DOUBLES GOLD DUTY TO 15% — World's #2 Consumer Hikes Tariffs as Record Imports Crush Rupee
snippet: India raised import taxes on gold and silver to 15% from 6%, the government's most aggressive tariff move in years after FY2025-26 gold imports surged 24% to an all-time high of $71.98 billion. Analysts see the hike dampening near-term demand in the world's second-largest gold market while potentially reviving smuggling networks that had been suppressed since 2024.

headline: ROYALTY ROLL-UP: Elemental Buys Vizsla for US$239M, Adds Panuco Silver-Gold NSR Stream
snippet: Elemental Royalty Corp. agreed to acquire Vizsla Royalties for C$327M (US$239M), securing 2.0–3.5% NSR royalties on the high-grade Panuco silver-gold project in Mexico's Sinaloa state at a 31% premium to Vizsla's last unaffected close. The deal adds an estimated 7,500 gold-equivalent ounces per year to Elemental's royalty book once Panuco reaches production.

headline: BONANZA GRADE in NEVADA: Scorpio Gold Drills 11.84 g/t Over 8.39m Including 40.15 g/t Interval
snippet: Scorpio Gold Corp. (TSX-V: SGN) drilled 11.84 g/t gold over 8.39 metres from 106.21m at its Goldwedge Mine in Nevada's Walker Lane Trend, highlighted by a 40.15 g/t bonanza interval over 0.88m. The step-out hole extends the known mineralized envelope 50 metres to the northeast as part of the Phase Two program at the Manhattan District Project.

headline: ZERO BLANKS: SAGA Metals Hits Ti-V-Fe Mineralization in All 57 Drill Holes at Labrador Critical Minerals Project
snippet: SAGA Metals Corp. (TSXV: SAGA) confirmed high-grade titanium-vanadium-iron oxide mineralization at its Radar Critical Minerals Project near Cartwright, Labrador — with standout intercepts of 52.05% Fe2O3, 7.21% TiO2, and 0.375% V2O5. The company has now drilled 11,600m and hit mineralization in every single one of 57 completed holes, with a maiden resource estimate targeted for H2 2026.

headline: URANIUM DRILL SEASON OPEN: Premier American Uranium Kicks Off 100,000-ft ISR Program in Wyoming
snippet: Premier American Uranium Inc. (TSXV: PUR) commenced its 2026 exploration drill program at the Kaycee ISR Uranium Project in Wyoming's Powder River Basin, targeting approximately 100,000 feet of delineation and expansion drilling. The program builds on prior results that progressively expanded the project's mineralized footprint at one of the most active in-situ recovery uranium districts in the US.

headline: COPPER SMASHES ALL-TIME HIGH at $6.69/lb — AI Data Centers and Grid Build-Out Collide With Tight Supply
snippet: Copper futures hit a record $6.69 per pound on Comex — the highest price ever recorded — as structural demand from AI data-centre build-outs, grid modernization, and the energy transition collided with tightening supply. LME copper also settled above $13,900/tonne on growing concern that US tariffs on refined metal imports could further squeeze domestic availability.

headline: CHINA HOARDING SILVER: 790+ Tonnes Imported in Early 2026 — GoldSeek Calls It the Industrial Supercycle Signal
snippet: GoldSeek's Gold SWOT analysis flags China's exceptional silver purchasing pace — over 790 tonnes imported in early 2026, driven predominantly by solar panel manufacturing — as the key structural divergence between silver and gold. The analysis argues this industrial floor is decoupling silver from gold's rate-sensitive correction, making sub-$90 silver a potential entry window before the next move higher.
